Name: SP's Onesies for Json Assets
Author: SpacePrincesss
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mfIienr.png[/img]﻿
[b]Thank you for downloading! [/b]This is my first ever mod, so I appreciate you taking a look and integrating it into your Stardew Valley experience.

[b]This mod allows hair while wearing the onesie. [/b]You may see your hair poking out, that's intentional.

[b][color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets Mod[/url] is required for this mod.[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff7700][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4734]Customize Anywhere[/url] mod is optional, but recommended for this mod.
[b][color=#ff7700][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] mod is optional, but recommended for this mod.[/color][/b][/color][/b]

[b]Includes (7) Animal Onesies[/b] (tails included!):
[list]
[*]Bear
[*]Blue Chicken
[*]Dog
[*]Elephant
[*]Kitty
[*]Panda Bear
[*]Unicorn
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/862RLZG.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4734][color=#ff7700]Customize Anywhere[/color][/url]will allow you to equip these items (hats/shirts/pants) using [code]LeftShift+4.[/code] 
[b][color=#ff7700][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url][/color] [/b]will allow you to equip these items (hats/shirts/pants) by pressing the letter [code]'i'[/code]on your keyboard (configurable) to open the spawn menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D60f1Vt.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]More Animals! [/b](Lion, Mouse, Pig, Raccoon, Squirrel, and more!)
[*][b]Boots [/b]for all the onesies!
[/list]
